basic_details.job_title: NIT Nagaland Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Nagaland (NIT Nagaland) has notified 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post on a project-based engagement for one year, extendable based on performance. The qualification required for the post is a B.E. / B.Tech, and M.E. / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Mechanical / Production and Computer Science. The pay for the Research Assistant post is Rs. 13,200/ month. Eligible candidates can apply by email or post by sending full details of qualification along with detailed bio data and photocopied certificates/mark sheets from 10th onward on or before 16 October 20

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed bio data and gather full details of your qualifications.
Compile photocopied certificates and mark sheets starting from the 10th standard.

Send the complete application along with documents to the postal address of Dr. Shambhu Kumar Mahato, Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Nagaland, Chumukedima, Dimapur, Nagaland-797103, or send them via email to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the specified address or email on or before 16 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: NIT Nagaland Research Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: AI-Assisted Self-Regulating Bio-Inspired Thermo-Fluidic Fogging and Waste Heat Driven Atmospheric Water Harvesting System for Zero-Water Green Mining Operations
TEXMIN CPS Centre of Excellence, NIT Nagaland, and Govt. of India

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential educational qualifications and meet the criteria specified for the Research Assistant post. Essential Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech, and M.E. / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Mechanical / Production and Computer Science, with at least 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA out of 10. Desirable Qualification: Working experience in Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, Manufacturing, and AI/ML.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Nagaland Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed bio data and gather full details of your qualifications. Compile photocopied certificates and mark sheets starting from the 10th standard. Send the complete application along with documents to the postal address of Dr. Shambhu Kumar Mahato, Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Nagaland, Chumukedima, Dimapur, Nagaland-797103, or send them via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the specified address or email on or before 16 October 2026.
